frontmatter.title: HTTP vs RPC vs WebSockets: Choosing the Right Communication Protocol for Your System
frontmatter.subheading: A practical engineering guide to understanding the fundamental differences between HTTP, RPC, and WebSockets - when each model fits, where each breaks down, and how to make the decision that will age well.
frontmatter.excerpt: HTTP, RPC, and WebSockets solve different communication problems. Learn how each works, when to use them, and how to avoid costly architectural mistakes.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
